title: 웹 편집 중복 방지 및 전산 원장 변경 감지 계약

actions.name: LEASE_ACQUIRE_HEARTBEAT_RELEASE
actions.baseline: BaselineDigest + Revision are server-authoritative; heartbeat preserves baseline and explicit refresh replaces it
actions.digestSplit: content digest excludes ShipmentMaster.isFix/ShipmentDetail.isFix; fixStatusDigest tracks positive-out detail confirmation separately
actions.conflict: different UserID or browser clientId returns ERP_EDIT_LOCKED during ordinary acquire; an explicit user action may take over a lease from the same UserID, invalidating the previous tab token and establishing the new lock-bound snapshot as baseline
actions.stableScope: estimate uses the parent week only, so unordered sub-week aggregation cannot reacquire then release the same lease
actions.tokenRotation: every explicit acquire/takeover rotates LeaseToken so late cleanup from the previous render cannot expire the renewed lease

actions.name: WRITE_GUARD
actions.snapshot: canonical SHA256 of parent-week rows; assert/advance take UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK, GET remains lock-free
actions.sequence: successful write advances server BaselineDigest so unfix-save-refix self writes remain valid; intervening EXE change returns ERP_EDIT_STALE

actions.name: OWN_WRITE_SETTLEMENT
actions.sidecar: heartbeat only; do not refresh/replace BaselineDigest
actions.sequence: keep client saving marker -> successful ERP transaction advances BaselineDigest -> heartbeat compares that baseline with live rows -> stale=false accepts own digest -> release saving marker
actions.externalRace: an EXE or other-window write after the web commit makes heartbeat stale=true and remains blocked
actions.failure: failed or partial save does not settle the client baseline

actions.name: EXPLICIT_EXE_CONFIRMATION_REFRESH
actions.sequence: user opens confirmation status -> read live ShipmentDetail.isFix counts -> explicitly refresh owned lease baseline -> reload selected customer list/detail -> compare once more
actions.automaticPolling: must remain detection-only and must never replace the baseline
actions.reloadRecovery: if initial acquire finds a stale active lease owned by the exact same UserID+clientId, return its owner-only token while keeping stale=true so the explicit refresh button can accept the current ERP snapshot; never expose that token to another user or client
actions.lockSafety: never refresh or take over another user/browser lease

actions.name: PASTE_EXPLICIT_REANALYSIS_REFRESH
actions.sidecar: only an active WebErpEditLease owned by the same user; same-client leases refresh, different-client leases are explicitly taken over then refreshed
actions.sequence: user explicitly re-runs existing-match analysis -> latest order/distribution rows are loaded -> if the same browser still owns a stale lease left by an interrupted request, refresh that lease baseline; if a different browser client of the same user owns it, takeover with a lock-bound current snapshot then refresh -> enable a new guarded preflight
actions.lockSafety: never refresh, accept, or take over a lease owned by another user or browser client without same-user explicit reanalysis intent

actions.name: DEPLOYMENT_SAFE_SAVE_RECOVERY
actions.draft: sessionStorage scoped by OrderYear + parent OrderWeek + CustKey
actions.sequence: only network/502/503/504 -> preserve inputs -> wait for /api/ping -> read exact estimate rows -> already desired means success without another write; still expected means one retry; mixed/other means stop
actions.businessConflicts: 409, ERP_EDIT_STALE, ERP_EDIT_LOCKED, STOCK_SHORTAGE and validation failures are never automatically retried

actions.name: PASTE_BATCH_UNDO_ORIGINAL_ADD
actions.sequence: acquire all customer leases -> keep saving marker -> atomic undo with editGuard -> verify all rows -> refresh baseline -> release all leases -> enable button
actions.failure: one failure rolls back the transaction; timeout is treated as unknown and requires a fresh read

actions.name: PASTE_BATCH_UNDO_ORIGINAL_CANCEL
actions.sequence: acquire all customer leases -> keep saving marker -> atomic undo with editGuard -> verify all rows -> refresh baseline -> release all leases -> enable button
actions.failure: one failure rolls back the transaction; timeout is treated as unknown and requires a fresh read

crossYearFixture.description: 2025-32-02/CustKey=10 lease or digest must never block or include 2026-32-02/CustKey=10.
